source_passages.locator: How does Propel work / linking section
source_passages.support_scope: Access with permission through state EBT systems; select state, enter EBT login
User authorizes Propel to connect to Portal as agent

features.outcome: User links their state EBT portal account to Propel by selecting state and entering their portal credentials, granting permission to access EBT data.
happy_path: Propel connects to portal on user's behalf
features.auth_and_consent: User-provided state portal credentials; agent authorization under Terms 6.1 (CR-PR-08).
features.eligibility: CONDITIONAL by state: balance checking not available in Iowa per FAQ (CR-PR-02) and homepage (CR-PR-01); Montana also excluded per CR-PR-19 (contradicted elsewhere). Requires user's own state EBT portal login.
features.fees_and_limits: Free app (CR-PR-02); no fee documented for this feature.
features.upstream_partner: State EBT portal / processor (e.g., ebtEDGE, ConnectEBT, CalFresh, Lone Star per CR-PR-13)
features.next_step: Specify Upmore behavior and permission scope; keep DISCOVERED until built.
known_gaps: CONTRADICTION: homepage/FAQ (CR-PR-01, CR-PR-02) say 49 states + DC + PR, USVI, Guam with Iowa unsupported; campaign page CR-PR-19 says every state except Iowa AND Montana (52 states and territories); App Store CR-PR-13 says 53 states and territories; state guide pages CR-PR-17 (Iowa) and CR-PR-18 (Montana) promote balance checking there; security page CR-PR-03 lists MT for lock/out-of-state/online blocking.
Credential storage/encryption details beyond policy text UNVERIFIED (app-only).
